name: library
description: A small public library: members borrow books and review them.
notes: loans.returned_on IS NULL means the book is still checked out.
A loan is overdue when returned_on IS NULL and due_on is earlier than TODAY.
A member has 'never borrowed' if they have no rows in loans.
Dates are ISO text (YYYY-MM-DD); compare them as text or with date()/strftime().
